lastSavedTimestamp.description:
Timestamp of the last saved version.  Subsequent updates to an instance will retain a `versionEdits` entry
to get back to the state of the instance at this time.  If this is null, there has been no explicit save
and no history will be retained until `updateAndSave` has been called.

savedVersion.description:
Maintains the saved version number.  If the latest version isn't saved, this will be `-1`.  As versions
are saved they are assigned saved versions numbers starting at 1.  There will be no gaps between saved
version numbers for saved versions.

versionEdits.description:
Every update to types that mix this type in will retain `versionEdit` entries to enable going back to any
previously saved version.

Completely and automatically managed by the system.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

targetType.description:
The type the rule is associated with. This association informs different parts of the platform to make informed
decisions, which may include but are not limited to filtering, indexing or execution.

detailsType.description:
@inheritDoc

ForeignKey rule returns a tuple of three values:
a) key: the fieldName of the targetType the rule is defined on, for which a match wasn't found.
b) value: the fieldValue of the fieldName for which a match wasn't found in the primary-key entity/table.
c) count: the number of entries for the given key and value that are missing.

args.description:
Any arguments passed to the **rule**. Please note that these arguments will serve as the base arguments before applying any
arguments passed at runtime to the {@link #run} or {@link #initRun} method.

Note that **targetType** is required here, and an error will be thrown if it is passed as **argsOverride**. If not specified,
the rule's targetType will be used to start the {@link MapReduceJob} to execute the {@link #map} function.

kind.description: Kind of this rule. Please see {@link DataValidation.Rule.Kind} for more details.

runs.description:
List of all the runs executed for the current rule ordered by meta.created.
PLEASE DON'T USE THIS FOR ANYTHING!! {@link lastRun} is better suited for any application logic.
This is relevant and only needed to support computation of **lastRun**.

lastRun.description: Last Run executed for the Rule.

runIdempotencyArgsKeys.description:
Fields from {@link #args} which will decide the {@link DataValidation.Run#runGroup runGroup} of the run.
By default, all fields from the {@link #args} are ignored and this id depends on the {@link #id} of the rule.

schedule.description: Schedule to run this rule that will be passed to a corresponding {@link CronJob}.

enableUserNotifications.description:
Enables user notifications for this rule's runs.
When true, DataValidation notifications will be generated for run lifecycle events (for example, when a run fails or transitions from fail to pass)
and dispatched to the recipients specified by {@link #notifyUserIds} and {@link #notifyUserGroups}.
If both recipient lists are empty or the notification service is not configured, no notifications will be sent.

notifyUserIds.description: The desired list of user ids to send DataValidation notifications.

notifyUserGroups.description: The desired list of user groups to send DataValidation notifications.

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

disabled.description: If true, any {@link #cronJob} will be disabled.

disabledBy.description: User that disabled the rule. Automatically inferred when calling {@link #disable}

disabledAt.description: When rule was disabled. Automatically inferred when calling {@link #disable}

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

status.description:
Status of the rule derived from the {@link DataValidation.Run}. Please note that this is not persisted in the db
and won't be available by default. {@link #fetchByStatus} and {@link #fetchCountByStatus} should be used if status
needs to be used in filtering.

title:
**DataValidation.Rule.ForeignKey** will check for the referential integrity of all foreign keys present on the type.
Foreign keys include:
1. Foreign keys without any fkeyRef.
2. Stored Calc returning a Persistable subtype

If case there are any foreign keys which do not exist in the "primary table", then it will be returned ({@link DataValidation.Run.Details}) along
with the number of impacted rows. The output will look like: <key,value,count> as the three columns.

Please note that only **ParentPartitionable** subtypes of a **kv datastore** types are allowed to have foreign integrity checks.
Moreover, these checks will only look at the **parent** field and no other field on those types.

An error will be thrown during create / update if:
1) A non **ParentPartitionable kv datatsore** subtype is passed as targetType.
name: DataValidation.Rule.ForeignKey
